scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fitroom/shared && concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @fitroom/client" "npm run dev -w @fitroom/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fitroom/shared && npm run build -w @fitroom/server && npm run build -w @fitroom/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fitroom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fitroom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fitroom/server && npm run typecheck -w @fitroom/client
